name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/J1
top_fix: Reformat TaskWorkflowTest.java (one line per test) and add a 'port this to C#' appendix mapping the version check to EF Core concurrency tokens.
summary: Mutable Task + save-on-exit (backup App.java finally{saveTasksToDisk()}) turned into immutable versioned values with save-before-memory, bounded snapshot, atomic replace, cooperative lock and baseline check. name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/j2
top_fix: Publish the CLI menu numbering (currently only encoded in scripts/verify.py stdin strings) as a table, since 07-TRACE-LAB asks learners to drive the app by hand.
summary: Two independent file writes (saveBooks then saveBorrowers) collapsed into one strict bounded atomically-replaced snapshot, plus the record the design was missing: an immutable Loan receipt snapshotting the accepted title and borrower name so later renames cannot rewrite history. 44 Java + 9 process checks verified; source formatted and recompiled. Java, no HTTP/SQL.

name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/j3
top_fix: Close the ordering gap the course itself names: save the candidate snapshot before publishing to memory (App.java currently mutates then calls saveData at :101,134,148,166,203,220) and add an injected-IOException regression.
summary: Original getAccountById returned the service's live BankAccount, so any caller could move a balance without a transaction; fixed with detached copies, Money precision, transfers that build both history rows before mutating, and one atomically replaced snapshot. 28 tests (incl. 64 withdrawals over 8 threads) + 7 CLI scenarios verified. Weaker than its siblings: memory mutates before save and there is no cross-process protection - both disclosed.

name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/e12
top_fix: Fix the missing spaces before numerals in astraupskill/VERIFICATION.md ('all98', 'in92.54seconds', 'server500', 'and390-pixel') and add a function index for the 2,051-line services.js.
summary: Feature-flag platform. Bare fs.writeFileSync persistence replaced with a lease -> revision+SHA256 digest compare -> validated draft -> temp+flush -> renameSync -> publish sequence, plus If-Match optimistic concurrency at the HTTP boundary, typed contracts, token/role/project authorization, reference-safe deletes and audit history. Also fixes a real cache-identity bug where the SDK's If-None-Match/304 path could return one user's evaluation to another. I counted exactly 98 backend tests, matching the claim; 20 named Chromium workflows; zero npm deps.

name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/e20
top_fix: Lead 04-TESTING-AND-DEBUGGING.md with a filtered vitest command (the full suite takes 453s per unit-final.log) and add a line-numbered function index for the 2,602-line erp-service.ts.
summary: In-memory ERP that reset on restart moved onto SQLite with BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions and full rollback, versioned CRUD for eight master entities, hashed expiring sessions, and fixes for real defects incl. 'line.rate || item.purchasePrice' swallowing a zero rate (backup erp-service.ts:712) and a start script pointing at a path tsc never emits. 39 API/process tests + 7 browser scenarios verified; VERIFICATION rejects a prior 38-test run with nonzero exit and refuses to count 5 reruns as new tests. Caveat: SQLite holds the whole workspace as one JSON body column, so no relational modelling.
